recipes.title: Sourdough Bread
method: Mix flour and water, autolyse 1 hour
Add starter and salt, knead 10 min
recipes.personalNote: This was my first successful sourdough. It taught me that patience and precise measurement matter — just like in data pipelines.
recipes.alchemyPrinciple: Fermentation is gradient descent: small steps, long time, incredible results.

recipes.title: Spanish Tortilla
method: Fry gently in olive oil until soft
Drain and mix with beaten eggs
Cook in pan, flip to finish
recipes.personalNote: A staple from my grandmother. Simple ingredients, perfect technique.
recipes.alchemyPrinciple: Feature engineering: the right ingredients, prepared correctly, make all the difference.
